See also: Cafeteria, cafetería, caféteria, and cafétéria

English

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • caféteria (uncommon)
  • cafétéria (rare)
  • cafeterie (dated)

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Mexican Spanish cafetería (“coffeehouse”), from cafetera (“coffee maker”), from French cafetière, from café, from Ottoman Turkish قهوه (kahve) (Turkish kahve), from Arabic قَهْوَة (qahwa, “coffee”). Doublet of cafetière.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Received Pronunciation) IPA(key): /ˌkafəˈtɪə̯.ɹi.ə/
  • Audio (Southern England):(file)
  • (General American) IPA(key): /ˌkæfəˈtɪ(ə)ɹi.ə/
  • Rhymes: -ɪɹiə, -ɪəɹiə

Noun

[edit]
English Wikipedia has an article on:
cafeteria
Wikipedia

cafeteria (plural cafeterias)

  1. (chiefly US, Canada) A restaurant in which customers select their food at a counter then carry it on a tray to a table to eat.
  2. (chiefly US, Canada) A dining area in an institution where meals may be purchased (as above), provided, or brought in from elsewhere.

Synonyms

[edit]
  • lunchroom
  • (dining area in an institution): canteen
